products.title: Aura 200 Smart Waterless Diffuser
products.seoDescription: Control home fragrance without a water tank using a compact 200 ml waterless diffuser with timer controls and a US plug option.
products.conversionPromise: Compact waterless scent control without refilling a water tank.
products.descriptionHtml:
Control room fragrance without a water tank. Aura 200 combines a compact metal body, 200 ml capacity and straightforward timer controls for homes, studios and hospitality spaces.

Why choose Aura 200

  • Waterless two-fluid diffusion
  • 200 ml fragrance capacity
  • US plug configuration available
  • Metal housing with a compact footprint
  • Designed for household, hotel, commercial and spa settings

Before ordering

Fragrance oil is not promised with the device. Delivery timing is confirmed during order processing.

products.title: Atmos 1000 Connected HVAC Scent System
products.seoDescription: Control large-space fragrance with a 1000 ml HVAC scent diffuser featuring wall mounting plus Bluetooth and Wi-Fi app control.
products.conversionPromise: Connected scent control for large rooms and commercial spaces.
products.descriptionHtml:
Bring scheduled fragrance to a larger space from one connected unit. Atmos 1000 supports HVAC connection or secure wall mounting with device, Bluetooth and Wi-Fi controls.

Built for larger spaces

  • 1000 ml fragrance capacity
  • HVAC connection support
  • Secure wall-mount installation
  • Bluetooth and Wi-Fi app control
  • Waterless two-fluid diffusion

Before ordering

Confirm installation requirements for your HVAC system before purchase. Fragrance oil is sold separately. Delivery timing is confirmed during order processing.

Give pet areas their own dedicated air-care device. PureRoom is a rechargeable odor-control unit designed for spaces shared with cats and dogs.

Designed around pet spaces

products.title: GlowMist Automatic Car Aroma Diffuser
products.seoTitle: GlowMist Automatic Car Aroma Diffuser | Autivara
products.seoDescription: Add controlled fragrance to your center console with a compact USB-powered automatic car aroma diffuser and illuminated top ring.
products.conversionPromise: A compact automatic fragrance device designed for the center console.
products.descriptionHtml:
Add controlled fragrance from a device designed for your center console. GlowMist uses a USB-powered electric spray mechanism in a compact black-and-gold cylindrical body.

Designed for the car

  • USB-powered operation
  • Electric spray mechanism
  • Compact upright center-console placement
  • Illuminated circular top
  • Optional fragrance configurations from the supplier

Before ordering

This offer does not promise that fragrance is included. Keep the device upright and away from driving controls and airbags. Delivery timing is confirmed during order processing.
